collections.title: Full chord set v4
collections.description: Every chord type in Petrus's v4 chord pack on all 12 roots: 9 main chords in six positions, shell/drop-2 voicings, and 3-5 voicings of each extended and colour chord. One strike per clip at 110 BPM with its natural release, plus the exact MIDI that was played.

collections.title: Full chord set v4: synth arp
collections.description: The same 188 chords on all 12 roots as the v4 full chord set, played as a 16th-note arpeggio on Petrus's synth arp patch (tempo-synced at 110 BPM). One held chord per clip, arpeggiated through bar 1, with its natural release and decaying arp tail in bar 2, plus the exact MIDI that was played.
collections.lookup_note: each offering has chord, root, quality, instrument; one default voicing per chord (gesture "bounce", take 0), the rest gesture "alt"

collections.title: Full chord set v4: Choir
collections.excluded_note: 185 of the 2,256 chord clips are left out because the patch is about 20 dB quieter on C3-Db3 and from Ab5 up; those chords fall back to other voicings or instruments
collections.description: The same 188 chords on all 12 roots as the v4 full chord set, sung by Petrus's Choir patch. One held chord per clip at 110 BPM with a short release that ends well inside the 2-bar slot, plus the exact MIDI that was played.
collections.lookup_note: each offering has chord, root, quality, instrument; one default voicing per chord (gesture "bounce", take 0), the rest gesture "alt"
